more_info.overview: Benzoyl peroxide, also called dibenzoyl peroxide, is a crystalline organic peroxide used for bleaching in food manufacture. FDA describes chemical synthesis from benzoyl chloride, sodium hydroxide and hydrogen peroxide. The listed applications include flour and certain milk, whey and cheese processes. Its food-processing identity should be distinguished from medicinal preparations using the same chemical.
more_info.origin: Manufactured by reacting benzoyl chloride, sodium hydroxide and hydrogen peroxide. The resulting benzoyl peroxide is a synthetic crystalline compound. The food-grade specification and use conditions apply to the additive preparation.
